title: Effect of non-local interactions on the vortex solution in Bose-Einstein Condensates
score_note: Conventional (thick) xi0-core vortex solved via GP ODE BVP; second (thin) a-scale vortex branch demonstrated via non-local scale selection beta~1/a, generalized profiles for |s|=1,2,3, and the two-length-scale + energy-crossover comparison. Two distinct core scales (1.30 xi0 vs 1.41 a) and the thick-vortex existence boundary D^4=32 xi0^4 reproduced exactly. Thin branch reproduced at the paper's variational/analytic level (not an independent full non-local BVP) -- flagged in failure_analysis and open_questions.
